facts.fact: The government is stated to have allocated XAF 800,000,000 (about USD 1.3 million) to the operations of ANSSI, its National Cybersecurity Agency, for 2025; the document gives no event date, so its published date 2025-01 is used.

systems.system: Agence nationale de sécurité des systèmes d'information (ANSSI)
